purpose: No-trading planner graph for Ancient Invention materials, restored-artefact disassembly, current PvME perk recipes, and region-sensitive rare-component supply.

ancient_invention_materials.planner_value: Required for Ancient Invention production such as ancient gizmo shells; supply comes from Archaeology rather than combat Scavenging.
The cheap PvME starter Precise 6 route directly consumes Archaeology output, making restored artefacts a combat-power resource in a no-trading League.

High-level restored artefacts become the practical self-sufficient supply; Vintage also participates in Ancient Invention device/perk progression even where the current PvME combat perk shortlist does not consume it heavily.
A major high-level combat-perk bottleneck that cannot be bypassed by Scavenging; selected Archaeology access therefore directly affects advanced weapon perk practicality.

archaeology_disassembly_bands.planner_note: Low-level restored artefacts are the strong Historic/Classic route. Results are guaranteed ancient-material rolls in addition to normal Invention materials.
Higher-level artefacts switch away from the Historic/Classic-heavy distribution.

region_pressure: desert supplies both rare-component families through Heart of Gielinor
desert supplies both Shadow and Cywir components through Heart of Gielinor
asgarnia has a direct Dwarf multicannon supply route; other clockwork sources remain possible

rare_component_routes.discovery_requirement: Dwarven technology tree blueprint; 10 Dwarven Currency
rare_component_routes.natural_source: Corporeal Beast spirit shields and sigils
rare_component_routes.example_return: Arcane/divine/elysian/spectral spirit shields disassemble for 4 Corporeal components
rare_component_routes.region_evidence: Corporeal Beast's natural cave entrance is in the Wilderness; teleport convenience does not erase the native Forinthry dependency for planner sourcing.

rare_component_routes.natural_source: Hand cannons from the Chaos Dwarf Battlefield / Keldagrim progression
rare_component_routes.example_return: An augmented hand cannon disassembles for 7 Explosive components
requirements: Forgiveness of a Chaos Dwarf for the battlefield in normal-game progression
rare_component_routes.historical_catalyst_evidence: Catalyst classified Keldagrim under Fremennik: Mainland.

rare_component_routes.natural_source: Royal crossbow forged through Queen Black Dragon progression
rare_component_routes.example_return: Royal crossbow disassembles for 3 Dragonfire components
rare_component_routes.historical_catalyst_evidence: Catalyst classified Queen Black Dragon under Asgarnia: Port Sarim.

rare_component_routes.natural_source: Dwarf multicannon supply through the Dwarven Mine/Asgarnia route
rare_component_routes.planner_value: Directly feeds the current PvME Flanking 4 recipe.

rare_component_routes.discovery_requirement: Cave goblin technology tree blueprint; 10 Goblin Currency
rare_component_routes.natural_source: Void knight mace from Commendation Rewards
rare_component_routes.example_return: Void knight mace always disassembles for 1 Pestiferous component
rare_component_routes.planner_note: Do not force Void Knights' Outpost into an Equilibrium region until the League publishes transport/destination handling. Historical routing is inconsistent enough to keep this unresolved.

rare_component_routes.natural_source: Death Lotus equipment; Death Lotus darts combine Player-Owned Ports ancient bones with Ascension shards
rare_component_routes.planner_value: Capsarius/Monastery of Ascension access can supply the Ascension-shard side, but ancient bones remain a Player-Owned Ports dependency rather than a simple single-region farm.
